entries.title: Initial
entries.description: Due to not wanting to pay for multiple domains, I created a central landing page that can easily navigate to all of my projects.

entries.title: Presentation
entries.description: Having an end product doesn't show much of the problem solving behind creating my different projects. I wanted to make a way to go more in depth on this. Since this would be ideally updated weekly or daily, I wanted to make the data all separate the hosted site. To accomplish this, I decided to store different projects' histories in json files to be retrieved and parsed by the client side.

entries.title: Color Differentiation
entries.description: To make it easier to differentiate between projects, I added a different accent color to each project. This is stored in the master record json, and passed down to each project page to allow for handling a growing number of projects.
